entities.name: Gabrijel Bukatko
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gabrijel Bukatko was a Serbian Roman Catholic prelate and Croatian Greek Catholic hierarch. He was an Apostolic Administrator and Eparchial Bishop from 1950 to 1981 of the Eastern Catholic Eparchy of Križevci and a Coadjutor Archbishop from 1961 to 1964 and an archbishop from 1964 to 1980 of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Belgrade.
